notes.title: VTuber Assets Update
notes.content:
[b]RIGGED VTUBER ASSETS![/b]

There are Live2D assets and PNGs of Meet Your Oshi Lanyards/Badges within a folder named 'VTuber Assets' [u]in your install location[/u] so you can look super stylish while attending Dweebcon!

[i]\SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Meet Your Oshi\VTuber Assets[/i]

Enjoy!
